$note: What Mission Control adds to the Lobby's live manifest. mission-control-tools/lobby/package_lobby.mjs applies it; set-bridge-host.mjs edits network.connect and privacy_url. The purpose is written for every Lobby visitor: the program makes no network call unless the owner signs in or a visitor types a watch code.

network.purpose: The Lobby owner's private work panel. Nothing is sent unless the owner signs in or you type a watch code the owner shared.
